content.title: Wright State University: Admissions, Ranking, Acceptance Rate, Courses & Fees
content.text: Wright State University Highlights Wright State University, located in Dayton, Ohio, is a public research university with a diverse student body committed to providing quality education and research opportunities. The university offers more than 190 undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral degree programs in fields such as business, engineering, medicine, education, and liberal arts. Wright State University's faculty is highly qualified and experienced, bringing expertise from various fields to their teaching and research. Wright State University is well-known for its outstanding research and commitment to innovation. The Carnegie Foundation has designated the university as a 'very high research activity' institution, and its research funding has recently exceeded $100 million. Information Details Type of University Public Total Student Population 12,187 Percentage of International Student Population 6.3% Acceptance Rate 89.4% Student-Faculty Ratio 15:1 Number of Campuses (Domestic+ International) 2 (Dayton and Celina) Number of Scholarships Awarded Varies by year and program Official Website www.wright.edu About Campus and Accommodation Wright State University's main campus is in Dayton, Ohio, with satellite campuses in surrounding cities. The university's campus covers 557 acres and includes modern facilities for academic, research, and recreational activities. The university offers students on-campus housing options such as apartments and traditional residence halls. Apartments have private bedrooms and living areas, whereas residence halls have shared bedrooms and common areas. The following table provides an estimate of the cost of on-campus housing options for the 2022-23 academic year: Accommodation Type Cost (per year) Traditional Residence Hall (double occupancy) $9,072 Traditional Residence Hall (single occupancy) $10,320 Apartment-Style (2 bedrooms, 2 occupants) $10,096 Wright State University Global Ranking Both QS World University Rankings and Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings have ranked Wright State University. Wright State University was ranked #801-1000 in the world in the 2022 QS World University Rankings. In addition, it was ranked #234-244 in the United States. Wright State University was ranked #1001+ in the world in the 2022 World University Rankings. The university's ranking in the United States was not provided. Top Courses Offered at Wright State University Wright State University offers various undergraduate and graduate programs in various disciplines. Here are some of the university's most popular courses, along with their fees for both undergraduate and graduate degrees: Undergraduate Courses: Course Level Fees (per year) Business Administration UG $13,904 (in-state), $26,934 (out-of-state) Computer Science UG $13,904 (in-state), $26,934 (out-of-state) Psychology UG $13,904 (in-state), $26,934 (out-of-state) Nursing UG $13,904 (in-state), $26,934 (out-of-state) Mechanical Engineering UG $13,904 (in-state), $26,934 (out-of-state) Post-Graduate Courses: Course Level Fees (per year) Business Administration PG $18,144 (in-state), $24,840 (out-of-state) Computer Science PG $18,144 (in-state), $24,840 (out-of-state) Public Health PG $18,144 (in-state), $24,840 (out-of-state) Electrical Engineering PG $18,144 (in-state), $24,840 (out-of-state) MBA PG $20,880 (in-state), $29,010 (out-of-state) Wright State University Admission Process Wright State University's admission process varies depending on the program of study and level of study. Wright State University provides undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs. Choose the program that best meets your academic and professional objectives. Admission deadlines differ depending on the program and level of study. You should check the university's website for the specific program's admission deadlines. Fill out the online application form and submit the application fee. The application fee for undergraduate students is $30, while graduate students pay a fee that varies by program. Submit official transcripts from all schools attended, standardized test scores, and English proficiency. Transcripts from all schools attended, standardized test scores, English proficiency test scores (if applicable), letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, and resume/CV must be submitted. The timeline for admission decisions varies by program and level of study. The application is typically processed when the university receives all required documents and a decision is made within 2-4 weeks. Documents Required for Wright State University The documents required for admission to Wright State University may vary depending on the program of study and level of study. However, some common documents required for admission to the university are: Completed application form Official transcripts from all schools attended Standardized test scores (e.g., ACT, SAT, GRE, GMAT) English proficiency test scores (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS) for international students Letters of recommendation (usually 2-3) Statement of purpose or essay Resume or CV Application fee Exam Requirements for Wright State University For admission to Wright State University, several exams are required, including English proficiency exams for international students. In addition, the following exams are required for admission: Admissions to Undergraduate Programs: Most undergraduate programs require the ACT or SAT. However, the minimum score required varies by program. TOEFL or IELTS: required for international students who do not speak English as their first language. The minimum TOEFL iBT or IELTS score required is 79. Admission to Post-graduate courses: Most graduate programs require the GRE or GMAT. However, the minimum score required varies by program. TOEFL or IELTS: required for international students who do not speak English as their first language. The minimum TOEFL iBT or IELTS score required is 79. Wright State University Cost of Attendance The cost of attending Wright State University varies according to the program of study, level of study (undergraduate or graduate), and whether or not the student is an Ohio resident. The tables below provide an overview of the estimated cost of attendance at Wright State University for both undergraduate and graduate students. Undergraduate Courses: Program of Study Ohio Residents (per year) Non-Ohio Residents (per year) Business $11,326 - $12,346 $20,126 - $21,146 Engineering $11,606 - $12,626 $20,406 - $21,426 Nursing $11,636 - $12,656 $20,436 - $21,456 Education $11,006 - $12,026 $19,806 - $20,826 Computer Science $12,146 - $13,166 $21,046 - $22,066 Post-Graduate Courses: Program of Study Ohio Residents (per year) Non-Ohio Residents (per year) Business $9,118 - $14,446 $17,588 - $22,926 Engineering $11,372 - $12,726 $22,172 - $23,526 Nursing $11,636 - $12,656 $20,436 - $21,456 Education $10,468 - $11,988 $19,268 - $20,788 Computer Science $12,146 - $13,166 $21,046 - $22,066 The table below estimates the cost of living for Wright State University students. These estimates are based on 2021-2022 academic year costs and may differ depending on individual circumstances. Expense Estimated Cost (per year) On-campus housing $8,062 - $11,652 Off-campus living $8,062 - $11,652 Meals $3,812 - $4,988 Books and supplies $1,200 - $1,600 Transportation $2,108 - $2,756 Personal expenses $1,200 - $1,600 Available Scholarships for Wright State University The Wright Guarantee Scholarship covers all tuition and fees for four years of undergraduate study at Wright State University. To be eligible, students must be Ohio residents, have a high school GPA of 3.0 or higher, and an ACT composite score of 20 or higher. Academic Merit Scholarships: These scholarships are given to incoming freshmen who have excelled academically. Annual awards range from $1,000 to $10,000 and are renewable for a maximum of four years. Diversity Scholarships: Wright State University provides a variety of scholarships to promote campus diversity and inclusion. Students from underrepresented backgrounds or who have demonstrated a commitment to promoting diversity and inclusion are eligible for these scholarships. Scholarships for Studying Abroad: Wright State University offers several scholarships to help students with the costs of studying abroad. Academic achievement, financial need, and other criteria are used to award these scholarships. Departmental Scholarships: Many Wright State University departments offer scholarships to students pursuing specific majors or fields of study. These scholarships are typically awarded based on academic achievement, financial need, or other departmental criteria. Placements at Wright State University Wright State University provides various degree programs in fields such as business, engineering, healthcare, education, and many others. As a result, university graduates are well-equipped with the knowledge and skills needed to pursue successful careers in their chosen fields.
